messages:
Alex W: We're green for the infra apply window at 23:00 PDT. Plan is cross-account IAM + TGW egress rules. Keep everything staged and serial. DeployBot will run a canary in us-east-1 first.
DeployBot: Scheduled: terraform apply started for infra/main (run id r-20260320-01). Will do canary -> staggered AZ rollouts.
Priya S: Quick reminder: pin aws provider to 4.2.1 in providers.tf to avoid drift while we do the TGW changes. Add a checksum lock.
Jon P: +1 on provider pin. Can we do AZ-by-AZ serial applies? Suggest starting with `-target=module.tgw` and wait 10m between modules. Fallback plan if route leak: abort and revert.
Marta L: I'll take the TGW canary in us-east-1. If route attachments look wrong I'll abort and revert to commit abc123. Leaving logs open for 15m post-apply.
Lin H: OpsBot: set circuit-breaker: if error_rate>5% for 2m during apply, auto-abort. Also I added the evacuate playbook link: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/infra-evacuate
Alex W: Command I'll run locally for canary:
```
terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=prod.tfvars -target=module.tgw
```
Will pause and monitor for 10m before next target.
DeployBot: Apply succeeded for module.tgw (canary) in us-east-1. Outputs: tgw-attachment=att-09f, route-table updates applied.
Priya S: LGTM. Next: IAM role trust changes. Reminder to run SA rotation dry-run after IAM apply: `./scripts/rotate-sa.sh --dry-run`
Jon P: If IAM apply fails, rollback steps: `git revert HEAD && terraform apply -auto-approve` for the last change. We'll also revoke recent session tokens. Ops, can you pre-stage the revoke script?
OpsBot: Rollback playbook uploaded: /ops/runbooks/terraform-rollback.md. Oncall notify: @marta. I pre-staged `scripts/revoke-sessions.sh`.
Marta L: Oncall here. I'll watch cloudtrail and BGP sessions. If we see >3 healthy host failures or route flaps, I'll trigger revert and post a short postmortem.
Alex W: Proceeding to serial applies for remaining modules now. Ping in this thread if you see abnormal traffic or any DeployBot aborts. :thumbsup:
